Card Q&A.a: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include only either [Kiriha Aonuma] or 1 blue or black card with DigiXros requirements, can I only add 1 card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include both [Kiriha Aonuma] and 1 blue or black card with DigiXros requirements, can I add 1 card to my hand and trash the rest?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Kiriha Aonuma] and 1 blue or black card with DigiXros requirements among them to your hand. Trash the rest.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
